summary: The note describes Belleau Woods, a neighborhood in southeastern Lexington, Kentucky, United States. It defines the neighborhood's boundaries: Man o' War Boulevard to the south, Hickman Creek to the north and east, and a combination of Belleau Woods Drive and Greenfield Drive to the west.
one_line: Belleau Woods is a neighborhood in southeastern Lexington, Kentucky, bounded by Man o' War Boulevard, Hickman Creek, and Belleau Woods and Greenfield Drives.
key_facts: Belleau Woods is a neighborhood in southeastern Lexington, Kentucky, United States.
The southern boundary of Belleau Woods is Man o' War Boulevard.
Hickman Creek forms the northern and eastern boundaries of Belleau Woods.
The western boundary of Belleau Woods is a combination of Belleau Woods Drive and Greenfield Drive.
